0.content:
The Old Sire, Nikolay "Pakhan" Izmaylov, was president of the Energy Commission and Speaker of the High Table. Several months before the quest, he died abruptly; officially of illness. The last to see him were the Butcher and Vasiliy, which guards whisper but dare not discuss. In the Train Boneyard Zmei says "So it really was you" and Vasiliy answers "Yeah, it was me". He says the old man refused to let him take over his work, because the mission was complete, and that he lost control of himself.

Vasiliy also says the Old Sire died "by my hand", just as everyone eventually dies.

1.content: Vasiliy had the Izmaylov refine Kresnik Kristall as a key for a mechanism that would open the Shadow Realm. The device was built into a half-excavated tunnel in the Train Boneyard. Zmei fears that if it went wrong, villages and towns nearby would be drawn in, and that opening it would sink the High Table if the Druzhna learnt of it. Iryna warns the mine would collapse. Once Vasiliy falls, the device shuts down.

2.content: Zmei, Iryna, Sofya and the Traveler take a rented train to the Train Boneyard and enter using the password "Oedipus". The Izmaylov guards, already unsettled by seeing the Shadow Realm, attack the group when they spot the Luchkin. Vasiliy appears at the end of the cave, taunts his siblings, calls the Law a leash and the High Table a make-believe council, then fights. When beaten he says he cannot see, remembers being lost as a child, and asks Zmei to take him away. The tunnel shakes and the group flees.
